## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Two fixes are needed: `slugify` deletes non-ASCII letters, so accented or non-Latin titles get truncated or empty slugs, and the description is missing the `## Testing` section that AGENTS.md requires.

## Changes
This pull request adds `app/slug.py` with a `slugify(title)` helper. The helper lowercases the title, collapses runs of characters outside `[a-z0-9]` into one hyphen, and strips hyphens from both ends. It also adds parametrized tests in `tests/test_slug.py`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/slug.py:7 — correctness — Keep non-ASCII letters when building slugs — For the title `"Café Menu"`, `slugify` returns `"caf-menu"`, and for `"日本語"` it returns `""`. The ASCII-only class `[^a-z0-9]` treats letters like `é` as separators, even though the PR body says only "non-alphanumeric characters" are replaced. — Titles in other languages get mangled URLs, and different all-non-Latin titles all map to the same empty slug. — Fix: Transliterate with `unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", ...)` before substituting, or use `[\W_]+` with `re.UNICODE`, then add `"Café Menu"` to the cases in `test_slugify`.
- PR body — correctness — Add a `## Testing` section to the PR description — The description only describes behavior and has no `## Testing` section. AGENTS.md:4 requires one: "Every pull-request description has a `## Testing` section that says how the change was verified." — Maintainers can't tell from the description whether or how the new helper was verified.
